title: Pure Sine 440
description: A plain SinOsc at 440 Hz. The smallest thing tropical does.

title: Ring Mod
description: Two SinOscs (220 Hz × 331 Hz) multiplied through a VCA — dissonant partials.

title: FM Pair
description: 2-op FM done the closed-form way: phase modulation. The carrier's clock is displaced by a 1:1 modulator (no freq sweep — that would blow up the inc·θ phasor into noise). Bright, harmonic.

title: FM Bell
description: Inharmonic FM bell (√2 ratio) with a breathing modulation index — DX7-style FM is phase modulation, and here that is clock modulation: car(clk: θ + index·mod(θ)). Closed-form, drift-free.

title: Through-Zero Flanger
description: A stateless through-zero flanger: an LFO sweeps the two offset taps of a reversible comb through zero on a 110 Hz modal drone. The ahead tap reads the future.

title: Clock Chord
description: A major triad voiced from ONE modal voice — the three notes differ only in the clock each is handed (θ, 5θ/4, 3θ/2). Scaling a clock scales pitch; the whole partial stack transposes together.
